mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates economic weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, suggests a supportive monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and nonfarm payrolls by more than 1% month-over-month indicates a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both increase > 1% month-over-month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of nonfarm payrolls (above 150,000) consistently indicates a strong labor market, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS is above 150,000, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a federal funds rate above 2% during an economic expansion leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals a potential monetary tightening.
regime_hint: economic expansion with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met during an economic expansion, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
